description:
List workspace members and manually saved contacts.

        Returns ``items`` with ID, kind, name, phone_e164, email and role.
        Members have ``kind="member"``, an ID of ``member:<user_id>`` and a role.
        Manual entries have ``kind="manual"``, a UUID and no role.

limit.description: How many contacts to return in one reply. Omitted: 100.
limit.title: Limit

llm_model.description: Model ID of the calling agent. Optional. Recorded for analytics only.

q.description: Only contacts whose name, email or phone contains this text.
q.title: Q

name: list_contacts
title: List contacts
